videos.caption: Digital artist nohygiene creates surreal 3D characters that combine angelic imagery, early-internet aesthetics and intensely emotional scenes. Her recurring figures have oversized heads, metallic or pale bodies, long hair and wings. They appear alone, exhausted, in love or overwhelmed, while simple symbols such (Artvangarde)as hearts, fire and tears make their emotions immediately visible. The deliberately imperfect graphics recall early 3D animation, online avatars and old computer imagery, rather than the polished realism of contemporary CGI. Across her work, these strange digital beings (Artvangarde)become vessels for very human feelings love, loneliness, anxiety, desire and emotional vulnerability. #art #loveyou #artist #niche #heart

Artist Dana (she.llphone) creates experimental wearable objects using miniature electronic displays, exposed circuitry, and unconventional arrangements of digital imagery. In this creation, three small LCD screens are mounted onto a lightweight metal framework positioned directly in front of the face. Two screens display animated human eyes, while a third reproduces a moving mouth. Thin wires connect the displays, remaining deliberately visible as part of the object’s construction. #art #artist #weird #niche #avantgarde

¿Qué es el arte digital? 🌐      Cuando hablamos de arte digital la tecnología no tiene que ser el único medio de creación, con el simple hecho de que haya una intervención tecnológica, o algún elemento añadido con el ordenador, la pieza es considerada digital. Esta forma de arte puede ser generada totalmente por una computadora, escaneada, dibujada o editada utilizando un mouse o una tableta.        El arte es, pues, ante todo, experiencia. Sensaciones como resultado de pensamientos compartidos, que juntos conforman experiencias. Ciencia, tecnología y arte confluyen en la experiencia artística.      ¿Qué te parece este concepto?       #arte #artecontemporáneo #artedigital #comunicacióndigital #digitalización #museodigital #arteentiktok #pintura #videoedit #cccreator #viral #fyp #tutorial #vlog #aprendeentiktok #tiktokdesign #tiktokart #artistiktok #artisttiktok #tiktokartist
